title: The Dead Body That Tricked Hitler #shorts

lines.text: In 1943, Britain tricked Hitler with a dead body.
They dressed a corpse as a fake officer named Major William Martin, and chained a briefcase to his wrist.
Inside were fake letters, and even a photo of a fiancee, a ring receipt, and theater tickets.
A submarine dropped the body off the coast of Spain, hoping spies would find it.
They did. The secret papers said the Allies would invade Greece and Sardinia, so Hitler moved his troops there.
But the real target was Sicily, and the Allies landed in July. So, would you have believed the dead man?

sources: https://www.nationalww2museum.org/war/articles/secret-agents-secret-armies-operation-mincemeat (body put in sea ~Apr 29 1943, found Huelva Apr 30; fake Major William Martin, Royal Marines; briefcase chained to wrist; letters; fiancee letters and ring receipt; Spanish gave Germans copies; Hitler decided on May 14 Sicily not next target and reinforced Greece and Sardinia; Allied invasion of Sicily July 9 1943)

https://www.mentalfloss.com/article/49029/corpse-fooled-hitler (HMS Seraph released the body; fiancee photo, ring receipt, theater tickets; fake letter on Greece and Sardinia; Mincemeat Swallowed Whole)

facts.note: the dead man's real identity is officially Glyndwr Michael but is not stated in the video
